scene: Neighbors wait for their laundry together in a quiet corner laundromat on a rainy evening.
setting: a small corner laundromat with a row of round-door washing machines and rain-streaked windows

characters.action: folds a striped towel on the long counter
reads a paperback on a wooden bench
watches a machine spin with its nose close to the glass
carries a wicker basket of socks toward a dryer

props: a coin changer on the wall
potted pothos hanging from the ceiling
rain-streaked windows with a street outside
lights: the glow from the vending machine
